description: Formalize-first on the deuteron 1/h scale: (i) EXACT ℚ(q) reduction Q_β_proxy = E₀·h·(2−h)/2 (sympy-proved) ⟹ Δ_λ(D)=1/h ⟺ B_D = E₀·(1−h/2)·Δtr — the 1/h is the E₀ scale dressed by the smoothed bar-averaged crossing; (ii) Q_β = m_e·8G·h REFUTED-as-exact at the precision floor (0.06% near-match survives as observation); (iii) the zero-fit candidate errors vs AME under both Q_β forms. ii_exactness_refutation.verdict: REFUTED-as-exact, scope (b) for the EXACT claim only: with exact 50-dps inputs the gap (≈6e-4 production / ≈1e-3 proxy) is 40+ orders above the floor — Q_β = m_e·8G·h is not an identity at q₀. The 0.06% near-match survives as an observation: E₀·(2−h)/2 ≈ m_e·8G, an algebraic-vs-Catalan transcendental near-coincidence (Weinberg-cosh class)

iii_candidate.tier: observation-tier candidate, NOT wired (Δ_λ gate): the (1−h/2) dressing takes the E₀ route from +11.99% to +0.30% (proxy Q_β) / +0.12% (Kashiwara Q_β); wiring requires deriving the dressing from the binding functional
